title: Mussels in Wine & Cream
summary: A pound of mussels in a white wine and cream sauce. The sauce is a safe place to stop.

equipment.item: Large pot with a tight-fitting lid
Oven mitts or a thick towel

steps: **Sauté** the onion and garlic in the olive oil and butter for a minute, then add the thyme for another minute.
**Raise** the heat to very hot. Add the wine and let it boil for 1 minute.

pace.text: This is just a sauce at this point. You can stop, use it for something else, or just quit.

steps: **Rinse** the mussels and remove any hairy bits showing. (These are called the “beards”.)
**Add** the mussels to the boiling sauce and cover tightly. Let it boil until all the mussels are open, about 5 minutes or so. If some won’t open, just discard them: they aren’t fit to eat.
Enjoy with bread, toast or dry crackers. Lemon juice is nice too.
**Sauté** {qty:1/4 cup} onion and {qty:4} cloves garlic in butter and EVOO. When soft, add {qty:2 tbsp} thyme.
**Boil** {qty:1 cup} white wine for 1 minute. Add the mussels, cover, boil until all open (7–10 min). Trash the stubborn ones.
keys: Safe stop: once the wine has boiled, it’s a sauce
Serve with flatbread, toast, crackers, lemon
